title_en: Famous Restaurants (14/20): A Floating Restaurant in Hong Kong
note_en: 要么 A，要么 B means "either A or B" and offers two alternatives with nothing in between: 如今人们要么只能看老照片，要么只能靠记忆怀念它曾经的辉煌 "now people can either look at old photos or rely on memory." Unlike English, where "either" appears once, Chinese repeats 要么 before each option, and each one is usually a full verb phrase.
